summary.tl: Apat na tanong bago ka maglabas ng kahit pisong investment.
summary.en: Four questions to ask before you put a single peso into any investment.

body.tl: Walang totoong negosyo na walang risk. Kapag sobrang laki at sigurado ang pangako, huminto ka muna.
body.en: No real business is risk-free. If the promise is huge and certain, stop and think first.

body.tl: Ang co-op ay dapat CDA-registered. Ang kumpanyang humihingi ng investment ay dapat may lisensya mula sa SEC.
body.en: A co-op should be CDA-registered. A company asking for investments should have an SEC licence.

body.tl: Kung hindi nila maipaliwanag kung paano kumikita ang pera mo, hindi pa ito para sa iyo.
body.en: If they can't explain how your money earns, it isn't for you yet.

body.tl: "Ngayon lang" at "limited slots" ay pressure, hindi oportunidad. Ang legit, makakapaghintay.
body.en: "Today only" and "limited slots" are pressure, not opportunity. Anything legit can wait.

q.tl: May nag-message: "Doble ang pera mo in 30 days, guaranteed! Limited slots lang." Ano ang una mong gagawin?
q.en: Someone messages you: "Double your money in 30 days, guaranteed! Limited slots." What do you do first?

options.tl: Mag-invest agad bago maubos ang slots
options.en: Invest right away before the slots run out

options.tl: Alamin kung rehistrado sila at saan napupunta ang pera
options.en: Check if they are registered and where the money goes

options.tl: I-share sa GC para sabay-sabay kayo
options.en: Share it in the group chat so you can all join

right.tl: Tama. Rehistro at malinaw na paliwanag muna, bago ang kahit anong pera.
right.en: Right. Registration and a clear explanation first, before any money.

wrong.tl: Hindi pa. Ang "guaranteed" at "limited slots" ay dalawang red flag. Alamin muna kung rehistrado sila.
wrong.en: Not yet. "Guaranteed" and "limited slots" are two red flags. Check if they are registered first.

summary.tl: Bago mag-invest, may sandalan ka dapat kapag may biglaang gastos.
summary.en: Before investing, have a cushion for surprise expenses.

body.tl: Ang emergency fund ang sasalo sa biglaang gastos para hindi mo galawin ang investment mo.
body.en: Your emergency fund covers surprise costs so you don't have to touch your investment.

body.tl: Karaniwang payo: 3 hanggang 6 na buwan ng gastos mo. Pwedeng unti-unti, tuwing sweldo.
body.en: The usual advice: 3 to 6 months of your expenses. Build it a little every payday.

body.tl: Ilagay ito kung saan mo makukuha agad, hindi sa investment na may term.
body.en: Keep it somewhere you can get it right away, not in an investment with a fixed term.

body.tl: Kapag may sandalan ka na, ang sobra ang ipapalago mo. Hindi kailangang hintayin ang promotion.
body.en: Once you have a cushion, grow what's extra. No need to wait for a promotion.

q.tl: Nasira ang phone mo at kailangan mo ng ₱8,000 ngayong linggo. Saan dapat manggaling?
q.en: Your phone breaks and you need ₱8,000 this week. Where should it come from?

options.tl: Sa JVS na 3 taon pa bago matapos
options.en: A JVS with 3 years left in its term

right.tl: Tama. Para diyan mismo ang emergency fund.
right.en: Right. That's exactly what an emergency fund is for.

wrong.tl: Hindi ito. Ang investment na may term ay para sa goal, at ang 5-6 ay mabigat na utang. Emergency fund ang sasalo.
wrong.en: Not this one. A term investment is for a goal, and 5-6 is a heavy loan. Your emergency fund covers it.

summary.tl: Paano nagiging puhunan ng maliliit na negosyo ang pinagsama-samang ipon.
summary.en: How pooled savings become capital for small businesses.

body.tl: Ang ipon ng maraming member ay nagiging isang pool. Walang iisang tao ang may hawak.
body.en: Many members' savings become one pool. No single person holds it.

body.tl: Ang pool ang sumusuporta sa KaNegosyo partners, tulad ng mga may sari-sari store.
body.en: The pool supports KaNegosyo partners, like sari-sari store owners.

body.tl: Habang nagbabayad ang partners, umiikot ulit ang pera sa pool at sa members.
body.en: As partners pay back, the money cycles back to the pool and the members.

body.tl: Ang X-factor: lumalago ang pera mo habang may negosyong lumalago rin.
body.en: The X-factor: your money grows while a small business grows too.

q.tl: Nag-invest ka ng ₱10,000 sa JVS. Alin ang totoo?
q.en: You invest ₱10,000 in a JVS. Which is true?

options.tl: Napunta ang buong ₱10,000 sa iisang tindahang pinili mo
options.en: All ₱10,000 goes to one store you picked

options.tl: Sumama ito sa pool na sumusuporta sa maraming partner
options.en: It joins a pool that supports many partners
It just sits in a bank

right.tl: Tama. Pooled ang pera, kaya maraming partner ang nasusuportahan, hindi iisa.
right.en: Right. The money is pooled, so it supports many partners, not just one.

wrong.tl: Hindi eksakto. Pinagsasama ang pera ng members, at ang pool ang sumusuporta sa maraming partner.
wrong.en: Not quite. Members' money is pooled, and the pool supports many partners.

label.tl: Piliin ang epektong mahalaga sa iyo
label.en: Pick the impact you care about

title.tl: Paano lumalago ang pera (at bakit huli ito)
title.en: How money grows (and why it comes last)

summary.tl: Bakit ang kita ang huling tanong, hindi ang una.
summary.en: Why returns are the last question, not the first.

body.tl: Secure, Encashable, X-factor, saka Yield. Kapag kita ang unang binebenta sa iyo, mag-ingat.
body.en: Secure, Encashable, X-factor, then Yield. If returns are the first thing you're sold, be careful.

body.tl: Ang kita ng co-op ay nakadepende sa negosyo. Ang historical average ay hindi pangako.
body.en: The co-op's earnings depend on the businesses. A historical average is not a promise.

body.tl: Pang-house repair next summer? 6 na buwan. Pang-retiro? Mas mahaba. Ang goal ang pipili ng term.
body.en: House repair next summer? 6 months. Retirement? Longer. Your goal picks the term.

body.tl: Tingnan ang ibang options gaya ng Pag-IBIG MP2 o savings account. Walang masama sa pagkumpara.
body.en: Look at other options like Pag-IBIG MP2 or a savings account. There's nothing wrong with comparing.

q.tl: Bakit huli ang Yield (kita) sa SEXY?
q.en: Why does Yield (returns) come last in SEXY?

options.tl: Kasi dapat ligtas at makukuha mo muna ang pera bago isipin ang tubo
options.en: Because your money should be safe and withdrawable before you think about profit

right.tl: Tama. Mahalaga ang kita, pero ligtas at makukuha mo muna ang pera.
right.en: Right. Returns matter, but safety and access come first.

wrong.tl: Hindi ganoon. Mahalaga ang kita, pero inuuna ang kaligtasan at kung makukuha mo ang pera.
wrong.en: That's not it. Returns matter, but safety and being able to get your money come first.
